scope: Exact delivered nine-column cycle CSV schema; unresolved semantics are deliberately non-counting.

sources.projectContext: Public imPURE/PASCOE project material confirms installed sensors/transducers and process monitoring/data acquisition but does not publicly define every delivered channel.

requiredResolution: Define Analog Input[1] exact signal, unit and physical location.
Define Analog Input[2] exact signal, unit and physical location.
Define engineering units and physical/reference locations for HydPressure, ScrewPosition, TempMold1/2 and Pressure1/2.
Define the Time unit, sampling/time-base convention and any reset/origin rule.
Record any scale factors, offsets, calibration/zero references or acquisition transformations.
Distinguish direct measured channels from commands/setpoints or derived values using source documentation rather than abbreviated names.
acceptanceRule: No ImPure cycle numeric value enters the accepted measured-sample total until its source-backed meaning, engineering unit, time basis and command/actual role are sufficient for interpretation. Unknown fields remain unknown rather than inferred from names.
